subject: Handling of mouse hovering of line

messages.author: 48b3e9693ea76d3d
messages.subject: Handling of mouse hovering of line
parts:
Hi,

when I run hovering examples as listed in ?handle_click, everything
works fine.

If I try to hover line instead of point:

mtcars %>% ggvis(~mpg, ~wt) %>% layer_lines() %>%
handle_hover(function(data, ...) str(data))

data always represent the first point (mpg=10.4 and wt=5.25).
Is this expected? And could it be overcomed to get values for the
nearest point?

Thanks for any advice,
Stanislav

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Handling of mouse hovering of line
parts:
Not currently, this is a limitation of vega.
